shots.alt: Exchange screen showing listing browser, positions and orders panel, and the selected market detail column
shots.label: Layout
shots.title: Exchange split view
shots.text: The Exchange pairs the listing browser and player account panels with a detail column for the selected market.

shots.alt: Exchange listing browser with asset filter tabs, tickers, prices, deltas, and an out of range divider
shots.label: Listings
shots.title: Listing browser and asset filters
shots.text: The selector groups station, syndicate, commodity, basis, futures, and index listings while keeping out-of-range station books visible.

shots.alt: Exchange listing filter tabs for all assets, stations, syndicates, commodities, basis, futures, and indices
shots.label: Asset tabs
shots.title: Major asset classes
shots.text: The top filter row is the fastest way to move between physical logistics signals and pure market instruments.

shots.alt: Exchange detail column with quote header, chart, KPI, underlying panel, order book, time and sales, and order form
shots.label: Detail
shots.title: Selected market workspace
shots.text: The right column combines the listing art, quote, chart, KPI, underlying data, book, tape, and order entry.

shots.alt: Exchange KPI and underlying panels showing bid ask spread volume shares dividend and commodity fundamentals
shots.label: KPI
shots.title: KPI and underlying panels
shots.text: KPI summarizes quote quality and activity; Underlying explains what economic signal backs the selected listing.

shots.alt: Exchange order book showing ask rows, spread, bid rows, sizes, and cumulative depth bars
shots.label: Book
shots.title: Order book depth ladder
shots.text: Asks stack above the spread, bids stack below it, and cumulative size shows how much depth sits away from the spread.

shots.alt: Exchange time and sales panel showing recent ticks, prices, quantities, and buy or sell side markers
shots.label: Tape
shots.title: Time and sales tape
shots.text: The tape lists recent fills with tick, price, quantity, and whether the buyer or seller took liquidity.

shots.alt: Exchange place order form with Buy Sell Short side buttons quantity price use spot quick chips and submit button
shots.label: Orders
shots.title: Buy, sell, and short order form
shots.text: Spot assets use one compact form for buy limits, sell limits from held shares, and market shorts.

shots.alt: Exchange Positions tab with expanded long position showing stats close controls stop loss take profit and abandon action
shots.label: Positions
shots.title: Open long and short positions
shots.text: Expanding a position exposes mark, entry, value, P&L, close controls, stop-loss, take-profit, and abandon.

shots.alt: Exchange Orders tab with an expanded limit order showing quantity price adjust cancel and quick chips
shots.label: Limits
shots.title: Open limit orders
shots.text: The Orders tab lists player resting limits and lets each order be adjusted or canceled from its expanded row.

shots.alt: Exchange futures order form showing contracts, contract size, notional, margin, fee, expiry, and open long or short buttons
shots.label: Futures
shots.title: Futures contract order form
shots.text: Futures orders show contract count, spot mark, size, notional, margin, fee, expiry, and long or short open buttons.

shots.alt: Exchange Futures tab with an expanded short futures position showing mark entry contract size margin P and L expiry delivery and close action
shots.label: Futures P&L
shots.title: Open futures positions
shots.text: The Futures tab tracks contracts, mark-to-market P&L, margin, expiry, delivery station, and physical delivery readiness.

shots.alt: Exchange History tab showing tick action ticker quantity price cash flow and realized P and L columns
shots.label: Ledger
shots.title: Trade history ledger
shots.text: History records opens, adds, closes, covers, cash flow, realized P&L, and stop or take-profit tags when a trigger fires.

shots.alt: Exchange Insights tab showing ranked trade ideas with edge, suggested limit, status, and reason columns
shots.label: Insights
shots.title: Navigator market insights
shots.text: The Insights tab ranks trade ideas, edge, suggested limits, and blocked reasons when a navigator is aboard.

shots.alt: Exchange basis listing selected with underlying panel showing station, good, local price, spread versus spot, and local stock
shots.label: Basis
shots.title: Station basis listing
shots.text: Basis listings tie one station and one good together, exposing local price, spread versus universe spot, and local stock.

shots.alt: Exchange index listing selected with underlying panel showing sector basket member prices
shots.label: Index
shots.title: Sector and treasury indices
shots.text: Index listings summarize baskets such as sector commodities or overall station treasury health.
